newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SMM Finance Cayman prices and increases FRN.
newsitem.headline: SMM Finance Cayman prices and increases FRN.

text.p: The following issue has been increased and priced, said arranger Peregrine Fixed Income.

The size of the issue was raised to US$190 million from US$150 million. It was priced at 225 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate, in the middle of the 220-230 basis point range indicated at the issue's launch in January.
Details are as follows:
